thread:
maria gonzalez: quick heads up — AcmeEdge SI needs SOC2 summary + pen-test findings attached for marketplace listing. deadline Wed 9am PT.

samir (partnerships): who owns redaction? we need PII scrubbed before presign upload :eyes:

tj (sec): i'll own the redaction matrix. can olga/si confirm which artifacts contain hw serials and customer data?

olga (si): HW firmware logs + install reports include serials. we can provide sanitized copies. owner: olga. should we use masked serials like xxxx-1234?

evan (eng): upload path? we should use partner bucket + presigned workflow. suggest TTL 72h. also need a note about KMS key usage.

redwood-bot: deploy:artifact-uploader v2.1 triggered by @samir at 2026-03-20T18:30Z

maria gonzalez: proposal: 
- tj: redaction matrix
- olga: sanitized artifacts
- evan: presign uploads + bucket policy
- samir: coordinate SI + announce embargo

samir (partnerships): ok i'll draft the announcement + embargo window. public launch blocked until artifacts are presigned and QC'd.

tj (sec): redaction checklist draft:
```
- remove customer names
- mask device serials (last 4)
- strip IPs from logs
- remove any PII from screenshots
```

evan (eng): presign command we'll use (internal tool):
```
./presign --bucket partner-evidence --file acme-edge/sanitized.tar.gz --ttl 259200 --kms redwood-marketplace
```

olga (si): can confirm sanitized.tar.gz will be ready Tue EOD. need a quick pen-test follow-up: vuln V-442 requires firmware hash verification — does marketplace allow that artifact?

tj (sec): yes include hash only; do not upload private keys or raw signing keys. add note in matrix.

maria gonzalez: can someone take a quick runbook for last-minute pen findings during launch week? if pen team reports high sev, we pause announcement.

evan (eng): i'll add a runbook snippet to the release doc and wire an alert to eng-oncall + sec-oncall. snippet:
```
- severity >= 8 -> pause listing, notify PM, open incident channel
- severity 5-7 -> evaluate rollback to canary model
```

samir (partnerships): thanks—I'll lock embargo Thurs 12:00PT and start stakeholder ping now. tagging: @evan @tj @olga :thumbsup:

tj (sec): ack. I'll push the redaction matrix to the shared drive and leave comments for olga.

olga (si): thanks, will review tonight and confirm artifacts by Tue 20:00 PT.

redwood-bot: presign: link generated https://presign.internal/acme-edge/abc123 (expires in 72h)

maria gonzalez: perfect. final ask — legal needs attestations from SI that no customer PII is present. olga can you drop a one-line attestation in thread?

olga (si): attestation: "Acme SI attests that the uploaded artifacts have been sanitized to remove customer-identifiable information and sensitive keys." — olga

samir (partnerships): added to checklist. moving to next steps. :rocket:
